purpose: Reader-safe template for educational public-address whale-watch reports on Bionic Banker.
privacy_boundary: Use public addresses and explorer links only. Do not include private wallet data, client data, account data, seed phrases, private keys, or instructions to copy a trade.
publishing_cadence: Daily or biweekly after the watched-address list is source-reviewed.
aml_connection: Public blockchain rows can feed the AML learning layer as source records: address label, transaction source, movement type, pattern flags, missing context, and human-review question.
allowed_actions: Document public wallet movements as educational reports
Link to public blockchain explorers and public label sources
Record movement type, timing, size band, direction, and missing context
Connect recurring public patterns to AML review questions
blocked_actions: No trading advice or copy-trading instruction
No fund movement, wallet control, or account registration
No external submissions or Pancake unfreeze
No accusation, filing decision, KYC approval, or compliance verdict

report_fields.purpose: The public wallet, entity label, or watch-list name. Use a public label/source when available.
The public blockchain where the movement was observed.
Explorer, public label page, dashboard, or community-maintained public watch list.
Asset, amount band, transaction type, exchange in/out, bridge, swap, consolidation, or distribution.
When the row was observed and whether it relates to nearby market/news context.
Why the address or behavior is notable in public-market culture.
The human question this public row would raise inside a bounded review workflow.
What the row cannot know: intent, ownership, off-chain reason, customer identity, or full history.
The report is context only, not advice, accusation, or a compliance decision.

sample_record.title: Sample public-wallet watch row
sample_record.address_or_label: Community-known whale wallet or public entity label
sample_record.public_source: Public explorer and public label source
sample_record.what_moved: Large exchange deposit or withdrawal, size band only until source-reviewed
sample_record.timing: Observed near a market move or news window
sample_record.why_people_watch: Large public wallets can show behavior that traders discuss, but the movement does not reveal intent by itself.
sample_record.aml_review_question: Does the surrounding activity repeat a routing, exchange, bridge, mixer, or consolidation pattern that deserves slower human review?
sample_record.missing_context: Owner intent, private identity, off-chain reason, complete transaction history, and whether the movement relates to a trade.
sample_record.clear_limit: Educational public-address context only. Do not copy a trade, accuse a wallet, move funds, or treat this as a filing decision.

source_review_rule: A watched source is publishable only when the public label/source can be cited and the source trail keeps intent, ownership, identity, and trading meaning unresolved.
